title: Joy B NDE 247
content: On January 27, 1997, while in my local hospital, I suffered a cardiac arrest. After five minutes of resuscitation, I was brought back to life. I was then shipped by helicopter to the Medical University of South Carolina. During the resuscitation, a blood clot went to my left hand, closing the circulation. Gangrene set in. On January 28, (the next day), the doctors attempted to find the blood clot by performing an arteriogram. I went back into cardiac arrest. (They think I was allergenic to the dye used in the procedure.) This arrest was more serious. While in arrest, I could see myself floating in a gigantic bubble of light. I could see doctors and nurses all around the table, and my body was lying on the table. The room was very dimly lit. The next memory I have is that of a man talking to me. I KNEW it was God. I could not see His face because the light was so bright that encompassed Him. His voice was like none I had ever heard before -- so calm. I had a great sense of peace. I was not scared. He talked to me. He said that I was in heaven but that He was giving me a choice -- to either stay or return. He said, however that my work on earth was unfinished for Him, and that I was needed more on earth than in heaven. When He said that, I told Him I would return. At that point, He touched my left hand. My next memory is floating downward and seeing a father holding a young child in his arms. A woman was standing beside them, but moved with some nurses to another room. The woman I sensed was the mother of the child. She was crying. The man, who I believe was the father, was holding the boy and gingerly talking to him. The room was dim. The nurses seem to be consoling the woman. For some reason, she was taking something off -- like a gown. The next thing I remember seeing was the little boy floating upward in the same kind of bubble I was in. He was happy and enjoyed playing in the bubble. I remember seeing him smile. Then, it seems like I was fighting to get back into my body, and I was frantic. All I could think about was getting 'back' to reality, to my family. I was then in a coma for twelve days. When I woke-up, I had no memory of what had happened to me for weeks prior to my arrest, but I remembered what I just told you. I asked my parents (who had been with me through this entire ordeal) -- two days after being placed in my room from intensive care unit/coronary care unit -- 'What happened to the little boy?' My mother asked me what little boy I was talking about. I told her what I just told you. She began to cry. It seems that my family had met another family at the hospital. They had a little boy there who was dying. My sister found out that sometime during all this with me, he died. As I explained, what the child looked like and his age, it fitted exactly what they had been told about the little boy who died. I have questions: Was the little boy I saw leaving earth, the same one my family knew about? How could I even know anything about this -- I was in a coma? How could I remember what happened to me during this experience, but I couldn't remember what had happened prior to all this? Oh, by the way -- my gangrene hand. The doctor who was taking care of that aspect, wanted to amputate it. The other doctors said I was going to die within hours, so why cut off my hand. The hours became days and they had to re-access my hand. It seems that 'on its own' the blockage was gone. Each day found healing in it without even one dose of any form of antibiotics. The doctor even took pictures -- he was so astounded. He said that in his entire medical career, and he was even now a professor at the Medical University, he had never seen such a thing. He later upon a return visit told me that I was the sickest patient he had ever seen who lived to tell the story. In my heart I believe and I tell others, it was because GOD touched my hand in my near-death experience.

diagnosis.diagnosis_raw: Cardiac arrest (twice) with blood clot to left hand causing loss of circulation and gangrene.
diagnosis.disease_name: Cardiac arrest; arterial thrombosis/embolus to left hand with gangrene
diagnosis.severity_description: Cardiac arrest requiring resuscitation; second arrest described as more serious; gangrene in left hand; was considered near death within hours
diagnosis.prognosis_given: Other doctors said she was going to die within hours.
diagnosis.quality_of_life_impact: Coma for twelve days; left hand with gangrene and threatened amputation.
diagnosis.vascular_condition: Blood clot went to left hand during resuscitation, closing circulation; gangrene developed; later 'blockage was gone' without antibiotics.

treatment.treatments_raw: Resuscitation for cardiac arrest (twice); arteriogram attempt; helicopter transfer to Medical University of South Carolina; consideration of amputation (not performed).

remission_outcome.time_to_remission_raw: Over days (hours became days; each day found healing in it).
remission_outcome.verification_detail: Gangrenous hand improved daily; blockage 'on its own' was gone; no antibiotics were given; physician was astounded and took pictures; physician stated he had never seen such a thing and later said she was the sickest patient he had ever seen who lived to tell the story.
remission_outcome.physician_quote: He said that in his entire medical career, and he was even now a professor at the Medical University, he had never seen such a thing.
remission_outcome.tissue_regeneration_detail: Progressive healing of a gangrenous hand with restoration of circulation/blockage resolution, without antibiotics, avoiding planned amputation.

turner_factors.spiritual_practices_raw: Strong belief it was God; described God speaking to her; attributes healing to God touching her hand.
purpose_sources: sense of unfinished work/mission on earth
turner_factors.purpose_details: God told her her work on earth was unfinished and she was needed on earth; she chose to return.

existential_shift.surrender_description: Given a choice to stay in heaven or return; she chose to return after being told her work was unfinished.
existential_shift.transformation_narrative: She experienced profound peace, lack of fear, and a sense of divine purpose/mission during the NDE, and attributes subsequent healing to God's touch.
existential_shift.pivot_point_description: God touched her left hand after she agreed to return.
existential_shift.transformation_timing: NDE occurred during cardiac arrest on Jan 28, 1997; subsequent hand healing unfolded over following days.

anomalous_experience.experience_description: During cardiac arrest, perceived leaving body in a bubble of light, saw medical staff and her body; encountered God in bright light who offered choice to stay or return; God touched her left hand; later perceived a dying child in hospital and saw the child float upward; later family confirmed a child matching description died during that time.
anomalous_experience.experience_timing: During second cardiac arrest on Jan 28, 1997 (during arteriogram attempt).
anomalous_experience.message_content: Her work on earth was unfinished and she was needed more on earth than in heaven; she was given a choice to stay or return.

correspondential_markers.resolution_type: Divine encounter/choice to return and God touching her hand was described as preceding the unexpected physical healing of the gangrenous hand.

validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Narrative claims spontaneous resolution of an ischemic/gangrenous hand without antibiotics and avoidance of amputation, with physician astonishment and photographic documentation (not provided).
validation.extraction_notes: Case is not a cancer remission; healing outcome concerns vascular occlusion/gangrene resolution. No objective imaging/lab results or provided records; physician quotes are narrative only.

analysis.case_summary: In Jan 1997 the experiencer had two cardiac arrests during hospitalization/arteriogram workup and then a 12-day coma; during the second arrest she reported an NDE involving an encounter with God who touched her left hand. A blood clot had blocked circulation to the left hand causing gangrene and planned amputation, but over subsequent days the blockage resolved and the hand healed without antibiotics, which she and a physician described as extraordinary.
key_healing_factors: Near-death experience with perceived divine encounter and 'God touched my hand'
Strong spiritual attribution to divine intervention
Strong family presence/support during critical illness
unique_features: Reported veridical element: later asked family about a dying child she perceived during arrest/coma, matching a real child who died
Unexpected resolution of gangrene/vascular blockage without antibiotics and without amputation, per narrative
analysis.analysis_notes: This is primarily an NDE narrative with a medically unexpected recovery component (gangrene/vascular occlusion). Conventional acute care (resuscitation, attempted arteriogram, ICU) was present, so it is not a 'pure spontaneous remission' case.
